patches.title: One Empty Container Rule
patches.principle: If a container is opened and empty, do not open another of same type; check open surfaces or different types first.
patches.when_to_apply: When you open a container and find no target object inside.

patches.title: Scan All Items on Arrival
patches.principle: Upon reaching a new location, read the list of visible objects to identify the target before deciding next action.
patches.when_to_apply: When you move to any new surface or furniture.

patches.title: No Sink Without Object
patches.principle: Do not go to the sinkbasin unless you are already holding the object that needs cleaning.
patches.when_to_apply: When the task requires cleaning and you are not yet holding the target object.
